t: You're standing on Maiden Lane, a street in Covent Garden that runs between Bedford Street and Southampton Street. It is best known as the birthplace of the painter J. M. W. Turner, who was born here in 1775. Turner became one of the greatest British painters of the nineteenth century. He is admired for his expressive handling of light and atmosphere and his bold use of colour, which inspired the early Impressionists Claude Monet and Camille Pissarro.
